# A09-S168: Event preparation

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

Super cool, I'm glad that it's moving :-) It will be so exciting where
many who come. I have tried to prepare myself in a way that both
can be interesting for 5 and for 100.

It's going to be a wild week here: I have to present at the "AI & Humanities" conference
tomorrow, and then start with voter meetings over the weekend. I have all sorts of
fun things in the bag, so it will surely go well.

Totally agree that flyers just have to lead to voter declaration. Preferably with link, 
and a reminder to confirm. The front page can be: "The Synthetic Party - an
AI-driven, anti-political party alliance." And slogans: "The latest
party", "Are you with us?", "A good compass."

Here are five of the key issues, which should be possible to relate to, and which
each can spark some debate:

*The Synthetic Party's five key issues:*

1) Life with artificial intelligences as the eighth Sustainable Development Goal of the UN
2) Hundred thousand kroner in monthly basic income to Danes
3) Drawing lots shall ensure that everyone once in their life gets a seat in the Parliament
4) Use of artificial intelligence shall be permitted in school exams
5) All parents of minor children shall have a robot lawnmower
and/or vacuum cleaner

[…]
